document.abstract: Wheels have been turning for the Washington Convention ever since the Editorial-Papers Committee Meeting at Hollywood last October. In addition to specific plans for last April's Chicago Convention, general plans were laid for a year ahead and Joe Aiken, Papers Committee Vice-chairman for Washington, D.C., was welcomed and was promised cooperation from all present in his job as Program Chairman.
